# Q3 Operating Review Commentary

## Financial Acceleration & Retention
- Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) reached $14.2M, reflecting steady enterprise demand.
- Net Dollar Retention (NDR) contracted by 13 percentage points from 134% to 121% as several Tier-2 banking clients deferred seat expansions to Q4.
- Gross margin expanded to 78.5% driven by serverless infrastructure efficiency.

## Operational Reliability & Compliance
- Production incidents dropped to exactly 0 during Q3 (down from 2 in Q2), achieving 100% uptime SLA.
- APAC expansion reporting was revised under Definition v2.0 to incorporate multi-region tenancy; results are not directly comparable to Q2.
- Contingency capital contributions remained at $0.
